review: The hymn is the straying sailor's rescue: 1:1–4 is Isa 53:6 with Ps 107:23–30 and John 10:3, the chorus is Ps 18:3 (מִבְצַר) with Heb 6:18, 2:1–4 is Ps 119:60 with Ps 55:23, and 3:1–4 is Ps 4:9 with Rom 5:1.

1:3–4 keep the tender call as the Lord's own speech (the print sets it in «»), with the colon after וַיִּקְרָא and the invitation on the last line; the Hebrew does not add quotation marks inside the line.

1:4 מִפְרַץ הַשָּׁלוֹם — the Arabic مِينَا السَّلَام is 'the harbour of peace' (مِينَاء), and the Hebrew uses מִפְרָץ, the landing-place word of Judg 5:17, since biblical Hebrew has no separate harbour-noun and the stanza's image is a ship coming to land rather than a gift.
